I changed nothing this run, because there's no waiting work to start. Eight FEBio runs are going and all of them look healthy, but about 14 of the account's 32 cores are idle.

**Running now**
- **FEBio:** 8 runs started between 15:01 and 15:06, the first new work in about 47 hours.
  - 4 friction runs (physio_fric2): p060, p062, p109, p125.
  - 4 convergence tests on p062: numconv_dt, pen05, pen20, hz01.
  - Each has 4 cores of its own (no overlaps), and every log was written in the last 20 seconds.
  - numconv_dt resumed from its checkpoint, which is normal.
- **New task queue:** empty and nothing running. 1 task is done and the same 5 gate2 tasks are still failed.

**Resources**

| Resource | Use |
|---|---|
| CPU | 18.1 of 32 cores (about 2.3 per run), no throttling |
| Memory | 63 of 128 GB, no out-of-memory kills |
| GPUs | none of ours; other users are taking all 7 |
| Disk (/raid) | 1.6 TB free |

**Health**
- All 6 restart-recovery services are up. The watchdog keeps the scheduler, GPU sampler and preflight running.
- The scheduler and watchdog were restarted at 14:45; I didn't do that.
- The active-learning loop (`biocage_al_loop`) crashed and was restarted every 5 minutes from 14:22 to 14:43. The restarts stopped after 14:45 and the loop isn't running now.
- No runs have finished since 10-31 15:47.

**Needs a person**
1. If more physrot or numconv runs are planned, queue them now to use the idle cores. The scheduler would start one more 4-core run right away.
2. Someone who owns the active-learning loop should check why it kept crashing.
3. The 5 failed gate2 tasks still need a decision.

The report is `work/agents/foreman/report_20261102_1526.md`. I also overwrote `work/agents/foreman/status.json` and added a line to `work/ops/foreman_actions.log`.
